text:
Maria G: Draft ready for final pass — link in thread. Need: 1) confirmed CTO quote, 2) legal check on the benchmark language, 3) publish timing + webinar mention. @Josh P @Emily L @Samuel K please eyeball. :sparkles:

Josh P: quick read — looks good. small ask: can we avoid the phrase '10x faster' and use concrete median latency numbers instead? suggest: `median gen latency 230ms at 1k tokens` as the inline benchmark.

Samuel K: Opening paragraph needs to land warmer for product folks. Can we swap the second sentence to call out "production economics" earlier? 1-liner tweak: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost."

Emily L: flagged one legal nit — the paragraph about 'data never leaves' is risky. need to change to: "customer data is isolated in dedicated environments when requested". Also send me the internal eval that supports the latency claim.

Maria G: good catches — I can reword the residency line and replace the claim with Josh's suggested median latency text. I'll attach the eval summary in a follow-up.

Alex R: here's a short quote you can use: "Redwood makes inference predictable at scale — lowering latency variance so engineers can ship confidently." Use as-is or trim.

Maria G: perfect — inserting Alex's quote now. @Anna O we want to publish next Tuesday morning PST and run a companion webinar the same week. Can ops lock a publish window?

Anna O: locking Tuesday 10:00am PST slot for publish + webinar signup page. I'll provision the HubSpot form and send you the embed snippet.

Maria G: inbound lead routing: map form -> HubSpot list "Launch_Post_2026"; tag leads with `launch_source=product-post` and `webinar_invite=true`. Also add `benchmark_interested` checkbox to capture users who request the eval.

Anna O: noted. HubSpot mapping will be: list, tags, and a workflow to add to nurture sequence. I'll share the form iframe and test URL by EOD tomorrow.

Emily L: legal sign-off granted on the revised residency phrasing and the Alex quote. Still want the eval doc attached before publish for audit.

Josh P: content + benchmark phrasing approved from product side.

Samuel K: tone and headline tweak approved — looks like a clean run.

Maria G: thanks everyone. I'll push final copy to the doc, attach eval, and request the publish slot in CMS. @publish-bot can you schedule the CMS publish for 2026-03-31T10:00:00-08:00? :calendar: 

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post "Redwood Inference — Predictable Inference at Scale" set to publish 2026-03-31 10:00 PST. Webhook to HubSpot form configured.

Maria G: awesome — final checklist: embed snippet, eval attached, legal ok, ops mapping done. If no objections I will hit publish on Tuesday. :thumbsup:
